'''Nikoll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] as a [[High Lord]], soon after [[Time of the Rot|The Time of the Rot]]. During the preparation for Nikoll's wedding in [[Tahv]], all the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] local cake preparators were attacked by the Sith anarchist [[Parlan Spinner]].
